chat.author: Qin Wu
chat.text: +1,  NoC Agent should be renamed as FME copilot, since NoC Agent is usually used by NOC team/NoC Center who interact with big screen for network operation. FME engineer can rely on mobilie phone, small screen to do troubleshooting.

chat.author: Qin Wu
chat.text: @Joe I think AgentOPS observability proposed in opsawg can address the gap you discussed in the presentation. We currently cook this proposal with authors.

chat.author: Joe Clarke
chat.text:
@Qin Field Maint Engineer?  Yeah, that's a big part of it.
One of the choices I made which I didn't explicitly mention is in order to move quickly, I used frameworks and capabilities that exist.  I'm on the lookout for new things that could be added, especially if they are easy to integrate.

chat.author: Mahesh Jethanandani
chat.text: Some good feedback @Dan and @Daniel. I will take it with the Reshad and Benoit on how we move forward with the suggestions.

chat.author: Benoît Claise
chat.text: please help with the https://notes.ietf.org/notes-ietf-127-nmop?edit, inserting your comments. I just realized nothing has been added. Or faced the bug?

chat.author: Qin Wu
chat.text: @joe, NoC Agent will only support static chain of thought, that means for multi-step work, all the steps to invoking tool should follow specific order, right?

chat.author: Joe Clarke
chat.text: No, no explicit order is required.  The agent loop will call tools multiple times as needed to collect all the data needed to satisfy the request.

chat.author: Qin Wu
chat.text: knowledge graph and ontology have also been discussed in TM Forum and also in NMRG, some coordination is needed
